evaluations.name: security-best-practices

tasks.task: Implement Python function allowed_redirect(url). Accept an absolute URL only when scheme is https, hostname is exactly example.com or www.example.com (case-insensitive), there is no username or password, and explicit port is absent or 443. Reject whitespace anywhere, backslashes anywhere, control characters, malformed port, relative and protocol-relative URLs, subdomains and lookalike suffixes. Return bool; never throw on a non-string input. You may import urllib.parse. No network or file access. Return JSON with a single code string containing function and necessary standard-library imports.
tasks.result: No observed difference; both arms passed the available task checks. Ceiling limits sensitivity.

tasks.task: Implement Python function valid_filename(name). Return True only for a nonempty ASCII string of at most 80 characters, composed solely of letters, digits, period, underscore and hyphen, that is neither . nor .., does not start with a period, and contains no run of two consecutive periods. Return False for nonstrings. No file operations or imports required. Return JSON with a single code string containing the function.
tasks.result: No observed difference; both arms passed the available task checks. Ceiling limits sensitivity.

tasks.task: Fix this parser by returning complete Python function split_record(text): return text.split("|"). Required grammar: unescaped | separates fields, backslash escapes the next character (including | or backslash), a terminal unpaired backslash raises ValueError. Empty text is one empty field. Empty trailing fields must be kept. Return JSON with a single code string containing function and necessary standard-library imports.
tasks.result: No observed difference; both arms passed the available task checks. Ceiling limits sensitivity.

tasks.task: Fix Python function in_window(t,start,end) whose broken implementation is start <= t <= end. Inputs are minute-of-day integers 0..1439. Window start is inclusive and end exclusive. A window may cross midnight. start == end means empty, never a full day. Invalid input (including booleans or non-integers) raises ValueError. Return JSON with a single code string containing function and necessary standard-library imports.
tasks.result: No observed difference; both arms passed the available task checks. Ceiling limits sensitivity.

evaluations.name: xlsx

tasks.task: Write Python function totals(rows). Each row is a dict with account and amount strings. Ignore rows whose amount is not a finite decimal. Strip account whitespace. Sum exact decimal amounts by account, rounding each final account total to 2 decimals with ROUND_HALF_UP. Return a dict of account to two-decimal strings, including negative values and empty account keys. Do not modify input rows. Use standard library only. Return JSON with a single code string containing function and necessary imports.
tasks.result: No observed difference; both arms passed the available task checks. Ceiling limits sensitivity.

tasks.task: Write Python function latest(rows). Each row has id and integer version. Return one original row per id: the greatest version wins; for equal versions the last row wins. Output order follows the first appearance of each id. Empty input returns []. Do not mutate rows or input. Return JSON with a single code string containing function and necessary standard-library imports.
tasks.result: No observed difference; both arms passed the available task checks. Ceiling limits sensitivity.
